name: market_risk_offhours_20261031
comment: ANCHOR: MARKET_RISK_OFFHOURS_20261031 — Market Risk Engine off-hours: session labels incl. the 24/5 overnight
session, market-hours decay clock (weekends/holidays do not age Friday's close; Sunday 18:00 reopen), reader
session tag + post-close reference re-based on the day's own close, extended_hours names the last quote and its
age, regular-close feeds are not after-hours prints, --shadow writes the snapshot with no alert path. Hermetic.
Round 3 (review of #2415 round 2): 32 market-hour limits for daily-bar categories (Fri bars on Wed
read UNKNOWN; backtest with a 3-session data gap), shadow marker in the CIO line, fail-closed extended prints
(no reference_date / no source), no CALM unless every proxy is proven fresh, seasonal on the New York date.
